name: fm-deck
description: Firstmate deck for Claude Code: the Captain's Call decisions pane (/calls) and the Deck status line and band, reading the firstmate home summary. Its hooks module may load through CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS or Claude Code's tengu_plugin_hooks_modules rollout flag, but the mod activates only when CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS is exactly 1 and is otherwise a complete no-op.
